reviews.title: It’s just a great game!
reviews.text: I honestly really like this game! It is really well made and has a very epic style to it. The game difficulty feels balanced and achievable while still being challenging. There’s a lot of things you can do in it as well! However, there is one really small annoyance that I’d like fixed. The placement of where the button for the guild stuff is, is kind of annoying. The button is hidden with the other stuff in the menu drop down which makes it hard to remember it’s there and counterintuitive to use. But like I said it was a really small thing and to be fair there is a lot of stuff to fit on the screen and the game has a clean UI for the most part. Overall this is a great game and definitely would recommend giving it a try!

reviews.title: This is one of the games of all time.
reviews.text:
This game is actually one of the better mobile games I may have ever played. It may not have the most interactive gameplay and thats totally fine, it is an idle game after all. But its also not a seemingly never-ending grind of no progression. You are more often than not able to make decent progress every day if you keep up with doing tasks to get some free key items without needing to feel like needing to spend. It is genuinely such a huge breath of fresh air for an idle game that this is, most likely, the only review I have ever put on a game in the app store, and probably ever will. 

This game is really as close to perfect as a mobile game can be in my opinion. 

So I give it a perfect score. A 5/7.

reviews.title: Good Game, Bad Devs
reviews.text: For the duration of my time playing this game, I’ve liked it quite a lot, and I do think that the game’s is a rather good idle game. That said, the devs are extremely greedy and the game’s not really itself unless you pay at least $5 for the oath package. Another disgusting example of the developer’s greediness is for the raid conquest, they’ve made the boss’s second attack an unavoidable attack. The game has a stat called evasion rate and the best strategy for raid conquests is to retry until you can evade the boss’s second attack. Knowing this, the devs secretly (nowhere within the game do they tell you the attack ignores evade chance, and all of the other boss’s attacks can be evaded) made the boss’s second attack ignore evade chance, thus making the raid more stat dependent and incentivizing an even greater pay to win play style.
